nodes.svg_description: Centered flat vector easel and sign: a blush-pink rounded-rectangle sign panel sits behind a terracotta-orange wooden easel. The easel has a triangular head with a small circular cut-out, a short horizontal top shelf, a matching bottom shelf, a central vertical post, and two wide splayed legs with softly rounded ends. Colors: easel elements #C95E3E; sign panel #F3BBB1; cut-out shows background through.
